product.name: VESKEN trolley
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with a piece and 4 legs
steps.instruction: Join a piece and 4 legs (A, B, C, D, E), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A piece and 4 legs are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the VESKEN trolley. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (piece, about 55 cm), B (leg, about 27 cm), C (leg, about 27 cm), D (leg, about 27 cm), E (leg, about 27 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 71 cm tall.
In 5 assembly videos, people took about 20 seconds on this step. Take your time.
